METHOD: Boil the milk the night before and let it cool to room temperature. In a kneading trough or a large basin, place our sifted flour and the semolina. Make a small well and add the salt. Then, gradually add the milk and mix with your hands until you have a mixture. Add flour if needed. We don't want to form a dough. Rub the mixture with your hands and let it rest for a little while (about half an hour). Place a clean tablecloth on a table, and there we will pass the trahanas through the special sieve. If some pieces do not pass through, transfer them back to the trough and rub them again, adding a little flour. When we have passed all the mixture through, transfer the trahanas onto a clean sheet or tablecloth and spread it out on a bed or a large table in a shady place away from flies or other bugs. If this is not possible, cover it with tulle. Spread it in a thin layer so that it can dry. We leave it for about three or four days, stirring it occasionally. When it has dried, we pass it through the sifting screen to remove the excess flour and place it in a cloth bag or a glass jar.
